app.title: XsdViewer
menu.openFolder.title: Open every schema (*.xsd) of a folder and its sub-folders as a workspace named after the folder
menu.open.title: Choose schema files (through the server's own dialog when it has a display, so that their location is known and links can be followed)
menu.newWorkspace.title: Start an empty workspace: a new group of tabs
menu.openWorkspace.title: Open a saved workspace (*.xsdviewer.json) as a new group of tabs — several workspaces can be open together
menu.saveWorkspace.title: Save the location of the files of the active workspace in a workspace file (its own file is proposed)
menu.closeWorkspace.title: Close the active workspace and all its tabs
dialogs.unavailable: The server has no display: files are chosen in the browser, workspaces are unavailable
menu.quit.title: Stop the XsdViewer server and close this page
about.title: XsdViewer
about.description: Web-based viewer for XML Schema files: the graph of the schema objects and their links, and the source text.
export.title: Export the current view as a PNG image
option.builtins.title: Show XML Schema built-in types (xs:string, xs:int…) in the graph
tab.new.title: New tab
empty.title: Open an XSD file
empty.hint: File ▸ Open… (Ctrl+O), or drop a file anywhere in this window.
drop.hint: Drop the XSD file to open it
graph.back.title: Back to the previous node
graph.twoLevels.title: Also show what the linked objects link to (a further column on the right)
legend.optional.title: A dashed arrow is an optional link: minOccurs 0, optional attribute, branch of a choice. The number after a link's name is its cardinality: 1, 0..1, 1..*…
files.title: Files
info.title: Schema
quit.confirm: Stop the XsdViewer server and close this page?
quit.stoppedHint: The server has been shut down; you can close this window.
external.noLocation: {0} is not declared in this file and no xs:import / xs:include says where it is: choose the file declaring it
folder.listed: {0} schemas of {1} listed in Files, {2} opened (open the others from there)
linked.listed.one: {0} linked schema found: listed in Files
linked.listed.other: {0} linked schemas found: listed in Files, open them from there
workspace.empty: No open file with a known location: nothing to save
workspace.listed: {0}: {1} files listed in Files, {2} opened (open the others from there)
workspace.close: Close the workspace {0} and its tabs
compare.hint: Ctrl+click two workspaces to compare them
compare.button.title: Compare two workspaces: Ctrl+click their chips to select them, then compare (files paired by name)
compare.needTwo: Ctrl+click two workspace chips to select them, then compare
compare.title: Comparing {0} with {1}
compare.summary: {0} files: {1} identical, {2} different, {3} only in {4}, {5} only in {6}
compare.sameModel: Same declarations and links: the texts differ elsewhere (documentation, layout, facets…)
compare.textTooLarge: Line by line comparison not shown: the files differ too much or are too large
compare.businessOnly.title: Ignore what does not define the schema: XML comments, xs:annotation (documentation, appinfo), blank lines and indentation
compare.diffOnly.title: Hide the identical files, and in a file's comparison show only the changed lines with one line of context
